title: Apple Delays Smart Glasses Launch Over Privacy Issues, Report Says - CNET
summary: Apple is unlikely to include facial recognition in its smart glasses, Gurman said, and the glasses will also perform their AI processing on the device itself rather than sending the data back to Apple servers.
